# Statement forms and modifiers the emulator does not implement are named in the error.

SELECT SAFE.RAND()
=> error contains: The emulator does not support SAFE.RAND

SELECT x FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x WHERE x IN (SELECT SAFE.RAND())
=> error contains: The emulator does not support SAFE.RAND

WITH RECURSIVE c AS (SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM c WHERE n < 3) WITH DEPTH SELECT n FROM c
=> error contains: The emulator does not support WITH RECURSIVE depth modifier

CREATE TEMP TABLE t (a INT64); INSERT OR IGNORE INTO t (a) VALUES (1)
=> error contains: The emulator does not support INSERT with

CREATE TEMP TABLE t (a INT64); INSERT INTO t (a) VALUES (1) ASSERT_ROWS_MODIFIED 1
=> error contains: The emulator does not support INSERT with

CREATE TEMP TABLE t (a INT64); INSERT INTO t (a) VALUES (1) THEN RETURN a
=> error contains: The emulator does not support INSERT with

CREATE TEMP TABLE t (a INT64); UPDATE t SET a = 1 WHERE TRUE ASSERT_ROWS_MODIFIED 1
=> error contains: The emulator does not support UPDATE with

CREATE TEMP TABLE t (a INT64); CREATE TEMP VIEW v AS SELECT a FROM t
=> error contains: The emulator does not support temporary, recursive or value-table views

CREATE TEMP TABLE g (x INT64, y INT64 AS (x + 1)); SELECT 1
=> error contains: The emulator does not support generated columns

CREATE TEMP TABLE c (s STRUCT<x INT64 NOT NULL>) AS SELECT STRUCT(1 AS x) AS s; SELECT 1
=> error contains: The emulator does not support CREATE TABLE AS SELECT with nested NOT NULL

CREATE OR REPLACE SCHEMA errors_statements
=> error contains: The emulator does not support CREATE OR REPLACE SCHEMA

# BigQuery renames a duplicate column of a query result, but not documented how for these names.
SELECT 1 AS a, 2 AS a, 3 AS a
=> error contains: The emulator does not support these duplicate column names in a query result: a

SELECT 1 AS a, 2 AS a, 3 AS a_1
=> error contains: The emulator does not support these duplicate column names in a query result: a

# Nor how it names a value table's field repeated more than twice, or one whose positional name
# another field has.
SELECT AS STRUCT 1 AS a, 2 AS a, 3 AS a
=> error contains: The emulator does not support these duplicate field names in a value table result: a

SELECT AS STRUCT 1 AS a, 2 AS a, 3 AS _field_2
=> error contains: The emulator does not support these duplicate field names in a value table result: _field_2
